Raw unit ControlGroup is empty, own_cgroup is null, own_cgroup_empty_terminal is true, and the reconciliation has null/NA own-cgroup fields. Parent events remain high=2179/max=561/oom=0 relative to prelaunch; local events remain zero; all reconciled deltas are zero. No host-root fallback appears.

Later stop receipt binds the same invocation, exit=0 and caps before stop; raw stop bytes/hash match the receipt, and post-stop state is not-found/inactive/dead at 03:55:03.639362Z. V1’s preserved empty-ControlGroup KeyError happened before payload encoding and produced no stdout; V2’s reviewed --all correction enabled the metadata capture. No compute rerun is indicated.
